newsitem.title: Albania: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Oct 8 - Durres - five vessels in port operating, all discharging, of which 1 bulk cement, 2 building materials, 2 bulk wheat 2 vessels in roads awaiting berths of which 1 to discharge bagged chicken feed, 1 to discharge bagged wheat.

BULGARIA, Oct 7 - No labour troubles. Varna east 3 loading at berth, 3 discharging, 2 waiting at anchor to load, 4 awaiting orders. Varna west 9 loading at berth, 2 discharging, 3 waiting at anchor to load. Varna lesport/tankers no vessels. Bourgas east 4 loading at berth, 12 waiting at anchor to load, 5 to discharge, 9 under repairs/dry-docked, 14 due. Bourgas west 2 loading at berth. Tankers 1 loading at berth, 1 discharging.

CROATIA, Oct 7 - Rijeka - two vessels discharging at berth, 7 loading at berth 6 vessels under repairs/dry-docked 3 vessels anchored 3 vessels at inoperative berth 7 vessels due with delays expected. Zadar - two vessels discharging at berth 2 vessels under repairs/dry-docked 1 vessel due with delays expected. Rasa, Pula, Sibenik, Split, Dubrovnik - no vessels.

ESTONIA, Oct 7 - no labour problems. Tallinn - city port 2 vessels loading at bert(1 cars, 1 containers) 1 liner no vessels anchored, none due kopli 1 sawn timber vessel loading at berth no vessels anchored 5 vessels due. Muuga 4 vessels loading at berth (3 black oil, 1 fertiliser) 2 ferries 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load 3 vessels due. Parnu - one peat vessel loading at berth no vessels anchored 6 vessels due.

ITALY, Oct 8 - Naples, Salerno - no vessels in roads. Gaeta one bulker etb 9/10. Genoa 2 in roads, no delays, 35 berthed, 6 at dry-dock. Multedo oil harbour none in roads, no delays, 4 berthed. Savona none in roads, no delays, 2 berthed. Vado Ligure one in roads, 3 berthed. La Spezia none in roads, no delays, 5 berthed, 5 under repairs. Leghorn four in roads, 43 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo none in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour 3 in roads, 2 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour 1 in roads, 2 berthed. Sarroch nine in roads, 5 berthed. Taranto 15 in roads. Ravenna five in roads. Ancona/Falconara three in roads. Venice one in roads. Trieste five in roads.

LATVIA, Oct 8 - No strikes. Riga - 12 vessels in port, all operating, of which 3 timber loaders, 2 cotton loaders, 1 metal loader, 1 tanker loader, 1 car loader, 3 container dischargers, 1 fish discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 15 due. Ventspils - three in port 2 operating, 1 timber loader, 1 mop loader, 1 waiting. No delays, 11 due. Liepaja - five vessels in port, all operating. No vessels waiting, no delays, 2 due.

LITHUANIA, Oct 7 - Klaipeda 18 vessels in port of which 12 loading (3 metal, 1 potash, 1 fertiliser, 1 steel frameworks, 1 container, 1 steel coils, 1 cement, 1 rails, 2 oil), 6 discharging (4 fish, 1 general, 1 powder) 5 in roads, 25 due.

POLAND, Oct 8 - Gdynia six vessels operating, 4 loading at berth (2 grain, 2 general cargo), 2 discharging (1 general cargo, 1 bulker) 6 under repair/dry-docked, 1 general cargo waiting. 30 due. Gdansk - 15 operating, 11 loading at berth (2 coal, 2 bulkers, 5 general cargo, 2 grain), 4 discharging (3 bulkers, 1 tanker) 3 under repair/dry-docked, 1 waiting, 11 due.
PORTUGAL, Oct 7 - Leixoes eight vessels operating of which 7 general cargo, 1 container. No vessels awaiting berths Vacant places 8 piers with cranes, 1 without cranes, 1 container pier.

ROMANIA, Oct 8 - Constanta - 38 vessels operating, 17 general cargo (16 loading, 1 discharging), 9 bulkers (3 loading, 6 discharging), 4 bagged chemicals, 4 bagged cement, 1 container (all loading), 3 tankers discharging. 5 in roads, 4 to load (general cargo, 2 bulkers, 1 bagged chemicals), 1 tanker to discharge. Constanta south (Agigea) 3 operating, 1 loading general cargo, 2 bulkers (1 discharging, 1 loading). Mangalia - one bulker loading. Midia - two livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, Baltic Ports St. Petersburg - Oct 7 13 vessels operating, 8 loading (3 non-ferrous metals, 2 fertiliser, 1 containers, 1 metal, 1 heavy lift), 5 discharging (1 malt, 2 chicken, 1 pipe 1 bananas) 9 waiting, 11 due. Oct 8 no strikes. Kaliningrad - eight vessels in port, 7 operating as follows 1 coal loader, 2 scrap loaders, 2 fertiliser loaders, 1 cellulose loader, 1 fruit discharger, 1 waiting, No delays, 2 due. Vyborg - three in port operating, none waiting, no delays, 3 due.

Far eastern ports, Oct 8 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok 15 vessels in port of which 1 passenger, 7 loading (6 metal, 1 timber), 1 loading/discharging containers, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 10 in port, 6 loading (4 metal, 2 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - five in port of which 3 loading (1 coal, 1 metal, 1 timber), 1 loading/discharging containers, 1 waiting. Posyet - no vessels. Khasan - one loading metal.

Black Sea, Oct 7 - Novorossiysk 10 operating 7 loading (1 seeds, 1 steel, 1 cattle, 2 iron, 1 steel/paper, 1 various), 3 discharging (1 rice, 2 various) 4 in roads, 1 to load molasses, 3 to discharge (2 rice, 1 citrus) 20 due, 14 to load (1 molasses, 8 steel, 1 copper, 1 wire, 1 luggage, 1 fertiliser, 1 equipment), 6 to discharge (tobacco, zinc concentrates, 3 luggage, bananas) Oil terminal 3 loading, 2 crude, 1 fuel oil, 4 waiting to load crude, 7 due, 6 to load crude, 1 diesel.

SLOVENIA, Oct 7 - Koper 12 vessels berthed, 1 container loading/discharging, 7 loading, 3 bulkers, 3 general cargo, 1 livestock loading, 4 discharging, 2 bulkers, 2 reefers. 11 due over next 2 days, 3 containers to load/discharge, 2 bulkers to discharge, 2 tankers to discharge gasoline, 1 to load timber, 1 reefer to discharge, 2 livestock vessels to load.

SPAIN, Oct 4 - Santander nine vessels in port, 7 discharging (1 general, 2 scrap, 2 cars, 1 fertiliser, 1 gasoline), 2 loading caustic soda. Oct 7 Bilbao - 24 dry cargo vessels operating, 12 discharging, 8 loading, 4 loading/discharging. No delay. Aviles - no delay/congestion/strikes. Six in port, 1 loading zinc, 5 discharging (scrap, steel products, 2 iron ore, alumina). Gijon - no delays/congestion/strikes. Two in port, loading cement, discharging steel products. Sagunto 17 operating, 3 ro/ros discharging/loading, 1 loading cement/ discharging timber, 5 loading (2 surgical products, 1 timber, 2 fertiliser), 7 discharging (bananas, 6 surgical products), 1 discharging/loading surgical products. No delays.

UKRAINE, Oct 7 - Mariupol - eight vessels in port loading, 2 map, 2 coal, 3 steel, 1 sulphur. 5 in roads, 4 to load (sulphur, urea, map, containers), 1 to discharge/load containers, 21 due, 10 to load (8 steel, 1 map, 1 cargo not nominated), 9 to discharge (3 containers, 1 alumina, 1 chemicals, 1 coal, 2 equipment, 1 bauxite/fluorspar), 2 to discharge/load containers. Odessa five in port, 3 loading, 2 discharging, 2 in roads to load, 13 due, 9 to load, 3 to discharge, 1 to discharge/load containers. Oct 8 Odessa steel 3 berthed, 2 anchored, 5 due. Containers 1 berthed, 1 due, grain 1 berthed. Sugar 1 berthed, 1 due. Tankers 2 berthed, 1 anchored. General cargo 1 berthed, 2 due. Fertiliser 1 berthed, 1 due. Ilichevsk steel 9 berthed, 2 anchored, containers 1 berthed. Tankers 1 berthed. General 2 berthed, 1 anchored. Fertiliser 1 berthed. Magnetite 1 berthed.

Yugoslavia, Oct 8 - Bar 12 vessels berthed, 9 discharging (3 soda, 1 petcoke, 1 gasoline, 1 chrome ore, 1 general, 1 fertiliser 1 anodes), 3 loading (2 copper cathodes, 1 aluminium) 4 ferries on lines bar-bari-bar, bar-koper-trieste-bar, no delays. Zelenika - two berthed, no operations, 2 under repairs.
